releases.summary: The first release of FieldCue: live audio-following cue control for marching band and other live music, on Windows and Mac.

changes.text: Follows the band: listens to the field mics, follows the music against your reference recording through tempo drift, held chords and rehearsal restarts, and fires cues at the right moment.
Built for the X32 / M32: mutes, fader levels, DCAs, buses, mute groups, scenes and snippets over OSC, with a connection check.
Any other console or device: Generic OSC outputs and the + OSC cue action send any OSC address with number or text values. Raw MIDI is there too.
Cue editor: waveform timeline, markers, beat grid with snap, drag-and-nudge cues, rehearse output and undo. Replace & move cues moves everything onto a new recording.
Live: GO, BACK, HOLD and Pause, click a marker to re-sync, PANIC with a safe-state cue, dry runs, and test runs from a recording.
Review: every run is logged, with a chart, playback and an accuracy check of each cue.
SFX 7's look and top line: File menu, Show, Review and Settings, with Click for Play Mode.
Auto-save every minute, crash recovery, File > Export Show Package, and a sample show with a quick start guide.
Windows 10 or 11, and Mac (Apple silicon and Intel) with macOS 12 Monterey or later.
Free trial, weekly rental or purchase. Activation needs the internet once, then FieldCue runs offline.
